final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.orderflow AS flow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avgfill, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderflow), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1) SELECT s1.flow, s1.avgfill, s1.cnt, CASE WHEN s2.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total END AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL
